sources.title: Visa-free or Visa-on-arrival Travel
sources.publisher: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
sources.officialityEvidence: GovHK's Immigration Clearance page directs HKSAR-passport holders to the Immigration Department's current combined visa-free-or-visa-on-arrival country list.

unresolved.reason: HKSAR's official outbound guidance groups Egypt as visa-free or visa-on-arrival; that combined label cannot normalize the exact Egyptian route. Egypt's eVisa schedule does not directly assign HKSAR passports.
